title: Removal of the Inboard Flap Track No. 2 Support Rib from the Wing Rear Spar

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Removal of the inboard flap track number two support rib from the wing rear spar with the flap supported, including the hole ovality measurement that decides whether a repair is needed before reinstallation.

sections.purpose: This task removes the inboard flap track number two support rib from the wing rear spar, so that it can be renewed or so that the rear spar boom land can be inspected and repaired.
sections.job_setup_note: The flap must be extended to the maintenance position and supported on the trestle set before the rib is disturbed, because the rib carries the flap load into the spar. Hydraulic power must be off and the flap system tagged. Measure the hole ovality before the bolts are cleaned, because cleaning can mask a light bearing surface.
sections.procedure: 1. Extend the flaps to the maintenance position and support them on the trestle set. 2. Remove hydraulic power and put the warning notices in the flight compartment. WARNING: DO NOT REMOVE THE FLAP TRESTLES AT ANY TIME WHILE THE SUPPORT RIB IS DISTURBED. THE FLAP WILL DROP. 3. Open the trailing edge access panels in zones 525 and 624. 4. Disconnect the damper at FIN 2VU and move it clear. 5. Measure the hole ovality at each of the attachment holes with the gauge set and record the readings before cleaning. CAUTION: DO NOT CLEAN THE HOLES BEFORE THE OVALITY IS MEASURED. CLEANING CAN MASK A LIGHT BEARING SURFACE. 6. Remove the barrel nuts AGS934342-5A and the attachment bolts, recording the position of each. 7. Support the rib D5730125554505 and lift it clear of the spar fitting D5730121797468. 8. Where the upper cleat GIR438406-76 is fitted, remove it and keep it with the rib. 9. Do a detailed visual inspection of the exposed spar boom land and record every finding. 10. Do an eddy current inspection of each attachment hole and of the boom land. 11. Protect the open holes with temporary plugs and cover the opening.
sections.close_out: Bag and label the removed bolts and nuts. Leave the flap on the trestles and the warning notices in place. Cover the trailing edge opening against weather. Make an entry in the aircraft technical log that the flap support rib is removed and that the flaps must not be operated.

safety_precautions: Support the flap on the trestle set before you disturb the rib.
Remove hydraulic power and tag the flap system.
Do not remove the trestles while the rib is disturbed.
Wear eye protection during fastener removal.

tooling.description: Eddy current bolt hole probe, 4 mm
